description: Read-only (eth_call) against any Ethereum contract, executed by our own Reth node. ERC-20 helpers balanceOf / allowance / decimals / symbol / name / totalSupply are built in; any other function can be called by passing its 4-byte `selector` plus ABI-encoded `parameter`. Nothing is signed or written. When to use: an agent needs an on-chain value without trusting a third-party API - a USDT/USDC balance, token decimals, an allowance, or any view function. Do not use: to send a transaction (this never writes), or for a historical balance. Returns: ok, contract, function, selector, output_type, value, value_human for known-decimals tokens.

function.description: balanceOf | allowance | decimals | symbol | name | totalSupply, or a label for a raw selector

parameter.description: ABI-encoded parameter hex (with an explicit selector)

selector.description: Explicit 4-byte selector hex for non-ERC-20 calls

name: eth_read_contract
